data.text: Live on kadence.guru: bogutskiandriy/kadence-site#27 (the rewrite) and #28 (two bugs found clicking through production: on a 375px phone the screenshots' minimum width leaked into the grid and the page laid out at 626px; the demo's 'as text' link still pointed at #how, which is the board now). Verified on the domain: 200, www redirects, the four screenshots serve as webp, innerWidth 375 on a phone. Left for the owner: the PostHog survey fires on demo_played — the click — and opens over the player; the site now tracks demo_finished, and the survey's trigger is a PostHog setting.
